title: Pay $100 extra on a car loan and see what happens
angle: $30,000 car loan at an assumed 8% APR for 72 months, with and without $100 extra a month

claims.text: $30,000 at 8% APR over 72 months costs about $526 a month and $7,872 in interest (amortization formula). Calculo proprio.
Paying $626 a month instead finishes in 58 months with $6,264 in interest, saving $1,608 and 14 months. Calculo proprio.
